annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades (Secretaría General de Coordinación de Política Científica; Grupo de Trabajo en Inteligencia Artificial)
key_provisions_or_claims: Six priorities: organisational structure, strategic areas, knowledge transfer, training, data ecosystem and infrastructure, AI ethics
Seven recommendations including launching a National AI Strategy and ethical use of AI
Strategic areas include public administration, education, smart cities, health, Industry 4.0, energy, security, tourism
Aligned with EU Coordinated Plan on AI and Agenda 2030 SDGs
Interministerial working group created to prepare the future National AI Strategy
annotation.summary_en: Spain's 2019 R&D&I strategy on artificial intelligence, prepared by an expert working group for the Ministry of Science. It sets six priorities and seven recommendations, covering organisation, strategic sectors, knowledge transfer, training, data infrastructure and ethics, and serves as the basis for a future National AI Strategy.
annotation.title_clean: Estrategia española de I+D+i en Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Spanish R&D&I Strategy in Artificial Intelligence
annotation.venue: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades
